pat: Profit after tax for the year
ni: Profit attributable to owners (equity holders) of the holding or parent company
nci: Profit attributable to non controlling interest
dps: Cash dividend per share for the year
bonus: Bonus shares percent for the year
eq: Total equity attributable to owners (or total shareholders' equity)
capex: Purchase of property, plant and equipment (fixed capital expenditure)
paidup: Paidup issued, subscribed and paid up share capital
